entries.title: Secrets has its own Settings section
entries.body: The new section shows whether protected storage is available. Protected storage is not enabled in this release, and existing sign-ins stay in their current storage. Other computers with an older Infinitary must update before they can run work with this copy. Older paired phones and viewing computers can still read, but must update before changing anything.

picture.alt: Secrets settings show Not enabled and unchanged sign-ins; the otherwise empty section intentionally offers no controls.
